notes.title: A horror adventure, Matsuro Palette now available!
notes.notes:
Survive seven days with a cursed painting! Will you be able to finish her?

The horror adventure game Matsuro Palette launches today, 11/15!
Enjoy a limited-time 10% off sale to celebrate this launch, alongside an OST available as DLC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321120/Matsuro_Palette/

Trapped in a dark atelier, the protagonist relies on the records of past victims to bring color to her painting. Can you end her story without angering the moody artwork?

An additional episode has been included, serving as a prequel to the main story—a glimpse into events before you ever met her.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34597517/547a05720a99a5b0143f0d727f09bfacc23387e8.png[/img]
